programme.title: Rise of the Nazis
programme.desc: At the end of the Second World War, British troops are confronted with the true horrors of Nazi crimes when they discover Bergen Belsen concentration camp.

programme.title: The Sky at Night

programme.title: Into the Ice
programme.desc: Three scientists go onto and into the Greenland ice sheet, further than anyone has travelled before, to find out how fast the ice is melting and gather the data that will help predict the future.

programme.title: Art on the BBC
programme.desc: Art Historian Katy Hessel examines six decades of BBC archive to create a television history of Claude Monet. Monet is known as the father of impressionism, the movement that arguably kick-started modern western art.

programme.title: Shooting the Past
